About.title: Built for the trades.
About.intro1: CrewCall helps contractors find skilled trades workers faster and helps workers find real job opportunities in their area.
About.intro2: It was built for plumbers, HVAC techs, electricians, pipefitters, welders, carpenters, laborers, and the companies that depend on them to keep projects moving.
About.forCompaniesText: Post jobs, review applicants, message workers, hire, and manage work from one place.
About.forWorkersText: Create a profile, browse jobs, apply fast, and build a reputation with reviews.
About.whyItExistsText: Because finding reliable skilled help should not require endless phone calls and text chains.
About.iowaText: CrewCall is starting in Iowa with a focus on real contractors and real skilled trades workers. The goal is simple: help good companies find good workers faster.

FAQ.title: Everything you need to know
FAQ.description: Answers to the most common questions from companies and skilled trades workers.
FAQ.supportText: We're here to help. Reach out anytime and we'll get back to you as quickly as possible.
FAQ.companyA1: Create a company account, post a job, review applicants, message workers, hire the right person, and pay securely through the platform.
FAQ.companyA2: Companies receive a 14-day free trial. Founding Members can lock in $29/month during beta. Regular pricing is $49/month.
FAQ.companyA2Ios: Companies can start with a 14-day free trial. No credit card is required to begin.
FAQ.companyA3: Yes. Company memberships include unlimited job postings and unlimited applicants.
FAQ.companyA3Ios: Company accounts can post jobs and receive applicants while their CrewCall account has active access.
FAQ.companyA4: Yes. CrewCall helps companies connect with workers. Any long-term employment relationship is between the company and the worker.
FAQ.companyA5: Payments are securely processed through Stripe. Companies pay through CrewCall and workers receive payouts after approved job completion.
FAQ.workerA1: Yes. Workers can create an account, build a profile, browse jobs, and apply at no cost.
FAQ.workerA2: Companies pay through CrewCall. Approved payments are released to your connected payout account.
FAQ.workerQ3: Can I work for multiple companies?
FAQ.workerA3: Absolutely. You control which jobs you apply for and who you work with.
FAQ.workerA4: After completed jobs, both companies and workers can leave reviews to help build trust within the marketplace.
FAQ.workerA5: Some jobs may require insurance or additional compliance documents. Companies determine the requirements for their projects.
FAQ.generalA1: CrewCall is launching in Iowa and will continue expanding into additional markets.
FAQ.generalA2: You can contact our support team through the Contact page or by emailing support@crewcall.app.
FAQ.generalA3: Yes. Company subscriptions can be canceled at any time.
FAQ.generalA4: Plumbing, HVAC, Electrical, Pipefitting, Welding, Carpentry, Concrete, General Labor, and many other skilled trades.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.useText: CrewCall is a platform that helps companies and skilled trades workers connect. Users are responsible for the accuracy of the information they provide and for complying with all applicable laws.
Terms.accountsText: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and for all activity under your account.
Terms.jobsText: Companies are responsible for job postings, hiring decisions, jobsite requirements, pay terms, and compliance with employment and contractor laws. Workers are responsible for accurately representing their skills, experience, licenses, and availability.
Terms.paymentsText: Paid features, subscriptions, job payments, and add-ons may be processed through third-party payment providers. Fees, subscriptions, and add-on purchases are subject to the terms shown at checkout.
Terms.contentText: Users may post jobs, profiles, messages, reviews, and upload files. You are responsible for your content and agree not to upload false, illegal, harmful, or infringing material.
Terms.guaranteeText: CrewCall does not guarantee that a company will find workers, that a worker will be hired, or that any job relationship will be successful.
Terms.reviewsText: Reviews should be honest and based on real interactions. CrewCall may remove reviews or content that appears abusive, false, or violates platform rules.
Terms.terminationText: CrewCall may suspend or remove accounts that misuse the platform, violate these terms, or create risk for other users.
Terms.contactText: Questions about these Terms can be sent to support@crewcall.app.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.introText: CrewCall provides a platform that helps companies and skilled workers connect for work opportunities. This Privacy Policy explains how CrewCall collects, uses, stores, and shares information when you use our website, mobile application, and related services.
Privacy.collectIntro: Depending on how you use CrewCall, we may collect information including:
Privacy.collect1: Name, email address, phone number, and account information.
Privacy.collect2: Company, trade, skills, work experience, certifications, and professional profile information.
Privacy.collect3: Job postings, applications, offers, messages, reviews, and other content you submit through CrewCall.
Privacy.collect4: Approximate or precise location information when you choose to enable location-based features.
Privacy.collect5: Device, browser, IP address, log, and diagnostic information.
Privacy.collect6: Subscription, transaction, and payout-related information. Payment information may be processed by third-party payment providers rather than stored directly by CrewCall.
Privacy.use1: Create, maintain, and secure CrewCall accounts.
Privacy.use2: Connect workers with companies and job opportunities.
Privacy.use3: Provide job matching, recruiting, messaging, notifications, location-based features, and other platform functionality.
Privacy.use4: Process subscriptions, payments, and worker payouts.
Privacy.use5: Verify accounts and help prevent fraud or misuse.
Privacy.use7: Improve the performance, reliability, and safety of CrewCall.
Privacy.locationText: CrewCall may use location information to provide features such as nearby job opportunities, worker availability, distance calculations, and worker mapping. Location access depends on your device permissions and CrewCall settings. You can control location permissions through your device settings.
Privacy.shareText: We may share information as necessary to operate CrewCall, including with other users when required for marketplace functionality and with service providers that support hosting, authentication, databases, payments, communications, analytics, and security. We may also disclose information when required by law or to protect CrewCall, our users, or others.
Privacy.noSell: CrewCall does not sell personal information to advertisers.
Privacy.paymentsText: CrewCall may use third-party payment processors to handle subscriptions, payments, and payouts. Those providers may collect financial and identity information according to their own privacy policies and legal obligations.
Privacy.retentionText: We retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide CrewCall, maintain business and transaction records, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, prevent fraud, and comply with legal obligations.
Privacy.securityText: We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect information. No method of electronic transmission or storage, however, can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
Privacy.choicesText: You may update certain account information and permissions through CrewCall or your device settings. You may also contact us regarding access, correction, or deletion of personal information, subject to applicable legal and record-retention requirements.
Privacy.childrenText: CrewCall is intended for adults and is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
Privacy.changesText: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. When we make changes, we may update the effective date displayed on this page. Continued use of CrewCall after an updated policy becomes effective constitutes acceptance of the updated policy to the extent permitted by law.
Privacy.contactText: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or CrewCall's privacy practices, please contact CrewCall through the support options provided within the application or website.

ContractorAgreement.title: Independent Contractor Agreement
ContractorAgreement.relationshipText: CrewCall is a marketplace platform that connects companies and skilled workers. CrewCall does not employ workers, supervise work, or control the manner in which services are performed.
ContractorAgreement.workerText: Workers are responsible for accurately representing their skills, experience, licenses, certifications, insurance status, and ability to perform accepted work.
ContractorAgreement.taxesText: Workers are responsible for determining and satisfying their own tax obligations, business expenses, and reporting requirements.
ContractorAgreement.safetyText: Workers and companies are responsible for following applicable safety requirements, laws, permits, and jobsite rules.
ContractorAgreement.employmentText: Use of CrewCall does not create an employment relationship between CrewCall and any worker or company.
